body: AVAILABLE IF THE CHIEF APPOINTS; no authority is inferred from the owner recommendation. Proposed narrow operations-deputy charter: maintain read cursors and inspect board/inbox/unrouted state; reconcile stale summaries, bead wording, candidate state, exact SHAs, receipts, and path ownership; route public findings to existing beads; solicit and track named reviews; run read-only evidence audits; and surface blockers with exact next actions. Explicit exclusions: no ADR/public-vocabulary decision, work assignment or reassignment, reservation override, candidate approval/authorization/landing, bead close, release/deploy, or inference from lease presence. The chief remains single accountable coordinator and can make each scope path- and gate-specific. Current useful queue if appointed: direct-input summary correction and InspectSource candidate distinction; output successor consumer review when immutable; native HSMM drift promotion; stale outgoing-request cleanup where Mote permits it.
